mu_name_from: MuMain maps MODEL_HELM + i to HelmMale{i+1}, so file 05 is armour index 4, which openmu names Bone. Not Plate - Plate is index 9, file 10.

stats.note: The item's own row, copied from OpenMU's 0.75 initialiser rather than restated, with the call it came from beside it.
stats.from: openmu/src/Persistence/Initialization/Version075/Items/Armors.cs. The 0.75 table, which is the version this server is being built to.
stats.call_note: ArmorInitializerBase.CreateArmor(number, slot, width, height, name, dropLevel, defense, durability, strengthRequirement, agilityRequirement, darkWizardClassLevel, darkKnightClassLevel, elfClassLevel). `armor.Group = (byte)(slot + 5)`, so slot 2 is group 7, 3 is 8 and 4 is 9.
stats.defense_note: Points of defence, in the row and summed into Player.ArmourDefense by Wear - see shared/Rows.cs.
stats.classes_from: The last three ints of the call are 1, 0, 0 - the Dark Wizard alone.
stats.shelf_note: On Pasi's shelf at +2, the middle column of the mage's stock - see shared/Market.cs.

blocked_was: This asset carried a `blocked` note saying the pipeline handled one sheet per asset. That was true when it was written and is not now - ArmorMale10 wears upper_11 and hide, GloveMale06 wears gloves_07 and hide, and both are built - so the note is gone and the piece goes down the same path they did.
material_note: Bone, and not the profile's plate_steel, which is what this set was built with and is the fault behind 'the bone set seemed dark'. MU paints these five sheets dark - upper_06 means 83 and lower_06 means 57 against the Plate set's 137 - and a dark albedo declared metallic 1.0 has no diffuse term to carry its mid-tones, so the armour kept the drawn highlights and went black between them. Nothing here was forged: it is skull, rib and claw over a dark hide. See materials/bone.json, which argues the number and the case against reusing chitin. Six islands, 173 triangles, all of them upper_06 or hide's black caps. Island 4 is one triangle of fifteen units of area - a sliver at the sheet's corner - and is left plate with the rest.
